AI keys, opt-in injection); checks npm and Python dependencies offline ("is this dependency safe?", "what changed in my deps?", "install X safely", "any AGPL in our deps?"); blocks secrets and risky agent config before commit ("add a pre-commit hook"); audits AI tooling ("audit my MCP servers / skills / hooks",…
